title: DeepSeek prepares IPO, reportedly chasing about $71bn valuation
summary: DeepSeek is reported to be preparing a listing and seeking about $1.5bn of fresh funding at roughly $71bn weeks after its first outside round; a filing could come by end-2026.

title: Stripe in talks to buy AI model marketplace OpenRouter for about $10 billion
summary: Payments firm Stripe is reported in talks to acquire OpenRouter, an AI model marketplace, at about $10bn versus a $1.3bn valuation set in a CapitalG-led round in May; WSJ-sourced.

title: Software firm CCC Intelligent Solutions exploring sale, sources say
summary: Insurance-claims software company CCC has hired Morgan Stanley and approached prospective buyers including private equity firms; shares rose 13% on the report.

title: EQT to sell Quantios, a SaaS provider to the trust and corporate services industry, to Vista Equity Partners
summary: EQT's Asia Mid-Market Opportunities Fund I agrees to sell Quantios (trust and corporate services SaaS, ~700 clients, built from Malaysia's ViewPoint and TrustQuay) to Vista. Terms undisclosed; close expected Q3 2026.

title: EQT sells Malaysia-rooted trust-software group Quantios to Vista Equity Partners
summary: EQT's Asia Mid-Market Opportunities Fund I agreed to sell Quantios (ViewPoint combined with Hg-backed TrustQuay; ~700 clients) to Vista; terms undisclosed, close expected Q3 2026.

title: Stripe in talks to acquire AI model marketplace OpenRouter for about $10 billion
summary: WSJ-reported talks for Stripe to buy OpenRouter, the unified model-API marketplace valued at about $1.3bn in May; no deal announced and talks could collapse.

title: Vista Equity Partners to buy Quantios from EQT and Hg
summary: EQT and Hg agreed to sell Quantios, trust and corporate services SaaS formed by merging Malaysia-based ViewPoint (EQT) and TrustQuay (Hg), to Vista Equity Partners. Price undisclosed; close expected Q3 2026.

title: Stripe in talks to buy AI model marketplace OpenRouter for about $10bn
summary: Payments firm Stripe is reported (WSJ, 23 Jul) to be in talks to acquire OpenRouter, an LLM marketplace valued at $1.3bn in May; neither company has confirmed. Open situation, not confirmed signed.
